name: R039-arcanine-overheat-weezing-memento
why: Challenge 7. The opponent's lead Weezing (501: Memento, Sludge Bomb, Facade, Destiny Bond) faces the player's Arcanine (656, White Herb, Overheat). Overheat is used every turn: White Herb undoes the first drop, so after four uses Sp. Atk is at -6 and the AI's bad-move check scores Memento against a target at minimum Sp. Atk (AI_CBM_Memento, battle_ai_scripts.s:483-484). Arcanine's Sp. Atk is modest (80), so Weezing (155 HP, Sitrus Berry) usually lives through the first three hits. Lost if Weezing uses Memento or Destiny Bond first or dies early; the lab seed varies the AI's choices and damage rolls.
